# GenXQR

> GenXQR (genxqr.com) is a QR code generator and management platform built in India. It makes free static QR codes with no account, and dynamic QR codes that can be edited after printing and track every scan by time, city, device and browser. Prices are in Indian rupees, and it supports UPI payment QR codes.

Key facts:

- Free generator, no account needed: URL, WiFi, WhatsApp, Instagram, UPI payment, SMS and phone QR codes, downloaded as 600 px PNG images. These codes hold their content directly, so they never expire and have no scan limit.
- Dynamic QR codes (paid plans, 14-day free trial, no card needed): 20 QR types including URL, PDF, vCard, menu, link-in-bio, image gallery, video, MP3, app download, coupon, Google review, UPI payment page, event and lead/feedback form. The destination can be changed at any time without reprinting.
- Scan analytics, A/B tests, smart routing by device, time, country and language, password protection, scan limits, expiry dates, folders, places (where each code is printed), bulk creation from CSV, team workspaces with roles, a REST API, webhooks, Zapier and Make apps, and an MCP server for AI assistants.
- Plans (monthly, in INR): Starter ₹299 (50 dynamic codes, 5,000 scans a month), Pro ₹799 (150 codes, unlimited scans, API, 1 custom domain), Business ₹2,499 (1,000 codes, white label, SSO, 5 custom domains), Agency ₹5,999 (shared pool for client accounts). Yearly billing costs less. Enterprise is by arrangement.
- Payments are handled by Cashfree. For UPI QR codes, money goes directly to the merchant's UPI ID; GenXQR never handles it.
